overview: The Parry 9214 Double Door Electric Plate Warmer is the perfect way to serve guests their food hot and fresh. The 825mm high double door design ensures that space is maximized in any restaurant as it can fit under the counter while still providing plenty of room for your plates. Plus, it's floor standing so you don't have to worry about mounting or cluttering your counterspace with another appliance. With the Parry 9214 Double Door Electric Plate Warmer, you'll be able to keep plates hot without worries!

This plate warmer makes it easy for busy restaurants, buffets, canteens or self-service eateries by allowing them to prepare warm plates ahead of time and store them at optimal temperatures until they're ready for service. For further functionality, the two shelves are easily removed for cleaning.
